metadata.title: Are AMD and Broadcom the real winners of the Nvidia spy scandal? - MarketWatch

content.text:
Tech Stocks
Are AMD and Broadcom the real winners of the Nvidia spy scandal?
The rival chip makers’ shares post big gains Monday — but those companies could also be subject to greater scrutiny over their sales practices, analysts say
The broiling scandal surrounding Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy may be bad news for Nvidia — but investors see it as an opportunity for its rivals.
Nvidia is probing whether Huang was targeted as part of a foreign-intelligence scheme, but said he will stay on as CEO “without interruption” and that business momentum won’t slow down.
